BCCI Secretary to Visit COE Amid Team India Injury Concerns

BCCI Secretary Devajit Saikia is scheduled to visit the Centre of Excellence (COE) to assess the ongoing injury crisis affecting Team India. During his visit, Saikia will meet with VVS Laxman to discuss the situation. Several players, including Jasprit Bumrah, B Sai Sudharsan, Harshit Rana, Nitish Kumar Reddy, and Washington Sundar, are currently sidelined due to various injuries.
